eventsPage.title: Worship Service
eventsPage.blurb: There's nothing like starting your Sunday together — heartfelt worship, a message rooted in Scripture, and a room full of people glad you came. Come as you are and jump in!

eventsPage.title: Bible Studies
eventsPage.blurb: Go deeper into God's Word in a relaxed, conversational setting where every question is welcome. Bring a friend — you'll leave encouraged!

eventsPage.title: Kids' Life
eventsPage.blurb: Kids from infant through 5th grade get their own safe, fun, Bible-based service during Sunday worship — secure check-in and background-checked volunteers in every room. They'll be asking to come back!

eventsPage.title: Student Life
eventsPage.blurb: Students in 6th–12th grade take over Wednesday nights with games, real talk, and faith that sticks. Bring a friend — there's a seat saved for you!

eventsPage.title: Family Night
eventsPage.blurb: Wednesday evenings are family night at Real Life — small groups for the grown-ups while Kids' Life and Student Life run for the younger crowd. One trip, something for everybody!

eventsPage.title: Christmas Play
eventsPage.blurb: The Christmas story comes to life on stage — music, laughter, and the wonder of that holy night, shared by our Real Life family. Bring the whole family and celebrate with us!
